Description

Prophecy of Vul is a story platformer about foxes. The story deals in themes of family, religion and acceptance with a colourful cast of memorable queer characters. The gameplay is simple 2D platforming with a focus on accessibility and presentation.

History

Prophecy of Vul has two priorities: to be finished and polished! After having enough of student projects, the studio was formed to make finished commercial games to a demanding audience. After hundreds of hours ironing out second-to-second gameplay, building UIs and fleshing the player experience, we stay committed to finishing this platformer and standing behind our work.

Features

  • An engaging, easily accessible core gameplay loop of platforming and collecting!
  • Easy to learn controls!
  • Various lovable characters!
  • Hand drawn pixel art!
  • An intimate story of self-realization!
  • Foxes! Multiple, even!

About Studio Kette

Boilerplate
Currently consisting of four employees, Studio Kette is dedicated to bringing accessible and enjoyable video game experiences to marginalized audiences. Our pilot project Prophecy of Vul is our initial foray into the industry and we are looking to only develop and hone our skills in our respective fields to bring the best out of ourselves!
